name: QphoX
description: QphoX develops quantum transducers that convert quantum information between microwave and optical frequencies, enabling quantum computers to network over standard telecom fiber. A spin-off from TU Delft's Quantum Nanoscience department, QphoX launched the first commercial quantum transducer in March 2026.

sources.title: QphoX Launches Breakthrough Product Allowing Distributed Quantum Computing Over Long-distance Optical Networks
